purpose: Predeclare and select the next Python character-n-gram baseline configuration without using calibration or test evidence for selection.

selection.training: Fit each candidate on train only.
selection.selection_split: Evaluate every candidate on validation only.
selection.eligibility: Meet all phase-01-quality-gate-002 baseline selection targets.
selection.ranking: Eligible first, then highest validation macro F1, then highest sensitive-like F1, then highest sensitive-like recall at 10% empirical FPR, then listed candidate order.
selection.confirmation: Refit only the selected candidate from scratch and report validation, calibration, and test aggregates. Calibration and test evidence never changes selection.

retention: in-memory only; no model, candidate text, context text, paths, record IDs, per-record predictions, or split membership is written
scope: Research model-selection evidence only. This contract does not authorize a scanner decision, policy change, model artifact, or Rust port.
